media.title: Everybody Sing (1938) — film poster
media.description: Promotional poster for Everybody Sing (1938), a Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer film represented in the Kaper database as Work W-F048 / Film F048. The image is sourced from Wikimedia Commons and has been treated as public domain in the United States under the pre-1978 no-notice rationale recorded there.
media.altText: Promotional poster for the MGM film Everybody Sing (1938).
media.rightsNote: Wikimedia Commons describes this as the poster for the 1938 film Everybody Sing, names MGM as author, and records a pre-1978 no-mark public-domain rationale. Commons states that it is public domain in the United States because it was published in the United States between 1931 and 1977 without a copyright notice; non-US jurisdictions may differ.
media.publicCreditLine: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer / Wikimedia Commons, public domain in the United States (pre-1978 no notice).
